Companion to the Technical Onsite Audit ยท numbering follows the final 30-issue client report

SCOPE. The audit was verified against the 34 live pages on www.tipinsure.com. The Screaming Frog crawl covers the whole tipinsure.com estate โ€” 194,759 URLs across 13 subdomains, 99% of it ft.tipinsure.com. Sheets are scoped to www.tipinsure.com so they agree with the report; where www returned nothing the whole-estate list is shown and the sheet says so. Every URL quoted in the report appears in one of these sheets. CRAWL: saved crawl 74f0c379, 23 Sep 2026. NOTE: ft.tipinsure.com is the legacy front-end due to be retired and replaced by www.tipinsure.com paths โ€” ft rows are listed so the behaviour is not carried over at migration.
